name: Declaration of Acquisition via Cohabitation with a Belgian Citizen

qualifying_event.description: Marriage to a Belgian citizen does not grant citizenship automatically. A reduced-condition declaration of acquisition is reported to be available for those who have cohabited with a Belgian-citizen spouse or partner in Belgium for at least 3 years.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage or partnership certificate; proof of 3 years' cohabitation in Belgium.

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be married to, or a registered/legal cohabiting partner of, a Belgian citizen. Reported to be gender-neutral, though this was not independently confirmed against primary legislative text in this pass.
At least 3 years of cohabitation with the Belgian-citizen spouse/partner in Belgium, reported as a condition additional to (not a replacement for) the standard declaration-of-acquisition framework.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of cohabitation in Belgium with the Belgian-citizen spouse/partner.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 3 years' cohabitation in Belgium

sources.title: Expatica -- Citizenship in Belgium: How to Become a Belgian Citizen: reports a 3-year cohabitation requirement for spouses/partners of Belgian citizens as part of the declaration-of-acquisition framework
